depiction.primary_object: vertical road segment with solid edges and dashed center line
depiction.composition: top-down road symbol with lower-right edit badge

readings.meaning: edit road or update map data
plan or customize a driving route
roadwork, street repair, or driveway paving
log driving mileage or trip itinerary

ambiguity: At small sizes the vertical solid and dashed bars can look like a barcode, pause symbol, or table column border adjustment.

reasoning: The icon depicts a top-down two-lane road segment combined with an edit pencil, directly representing map road editing, custom route planning, or street/driveway work. While useful for road-trip routing and GIS/mapping tasks, the three vertical bars can resemble a barcode or column divider at small sizes.
